fact: Burundi has pledged to join the East African Payment System by December 2026 and its integration project components were unfinished when the African Development Bank grant closed in June, the East African Legislative Assembly Committee on Accounts reported.

The Bank of the Republic of Burundi hosted training for local banks and the Post Office on connecting to COMESA's Regional Payment and Settlement System and Digital Regional Payment Platform, with connection under way and not yet stated in service.

fact: The Bank of the Republic of Burundi told EAC governors in July 2026 that Burundi's integration into the East African Payment System is targeted for completion by December 2026.
EAC central bank governors meeting in Kampala in July 2026 decided BurundiPay must be interconnected with other member states' payment systems for cross-border payments.
The BRB has acceded to PAPSS, with four Burundian banks authorised to take part, says BRB's Nduwimana Libere.
